1.web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
1.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:

2.web: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
2.asv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

3.web: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
3.asv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

4.web: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.
4.asv: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;

5.web: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
5.asv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.

6.web: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
6.asv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.

7.web: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
7.asv: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away

8.web: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
8.asv: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.

9.web: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
9.asv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.

10.web: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
10.asv: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;

11.web: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
11.asv: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.

12.web: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
12.asv: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.

13.web: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
13.asv: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

14.web: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
14.asv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,

15.web: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
15.asv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Andoil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man’s heart.

16.web: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
16.asv: The trees of Jehovah are filledwith moisture, The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

17.web: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.
17.asv: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

18.web: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
18.asv: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.

19.web: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
19.asv: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.

20.web: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
20.asv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

21.web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
21.asv: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

22.web: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.
22.asv: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.

23.web: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
23.asv: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.

24.web: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
24.asv: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.

25.web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
25.asv: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.

26.web: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
26.asv: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.

27.web: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
27.asv: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.

28.web: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
28.asv: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

29.web: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.
29.asv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.

30.web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
30.asv: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.

31.web: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.
31.asv: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:

32.web: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
32.asv: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

33.web: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
33.asv: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

34.web: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.
34.asv: Let my meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.

35.web: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
35.asv: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
